set.body:
Goal: expose bounded-memory byte streaming while keeping the parser pure and deterministic.

Acceptance criteria:
- FS2 input handles arbitrary byte boundaries, CRLF/LF, final unterminated lines, and very long lines under explicit size limits.
- Every byte and physical line is consumed exactly once or returned in a named diagnostic.
- Streaming emissions match pure whole-input parsing for every tested chunk partition.
- Cancellation closes resources and never publishes a partial result as complete.
- Buffer and maximum-line budgets are validated before allocation.
- JVM file streaming and Scala.js in-memory or platform-appropriate streaming exercise the same pure parser.
- A multi-million-line synthetic fixture demonstrates parser memory bounded by configured buffers, excluding intentional downstream materialization.
set.title: Build the chunk-invariant FS2 EyeLink ASC streaming adapter
